question: Do independently published pre-soft-s GR/PPN or equivalence-principle conditions uniquely select the scalar-response-relevant coupling parameters of the projectable universal HMT/U(1) matter-coupling family, without using RTK pole/residue/remainder or the observed soft-s obstruction?

independent_sources.role: published universal HMT matter coupling and PPN/GR-limit constraints, including projectable case
independent review/source-lock for physical-ADM universal matter interface and its coupling-parameter status

decision_rule: UNIQUE_PASS requires a pre-soft-s published projectable HMT/U(1) IR-equivalence/PPN/equivalence-principle condition that fixes all matter-interface parameters relevant to the scalar response to a single source map. CONTINUOUS_FAMILY_PARTIAL_PASS applies if the published GR/PPN constraints explicitly admit a nontrivial region/family or leave at least one relevant coupling free, even while GR PPN values are achievable. BLOCKED applies if no independent pre-soft-s coefficient-selection condition can be source-locked. No RTK finite-k, pole/residue/remainder, soft-s or k=0.03 result may be used to select coefficients.
required_guards: sources predate current RTK soft-s obstruction
projectable case must be explicitly represented
no coefficients selected from RTK pole/residue/remainder
no coefficients selected from failed soft-s observable
do not promote a phenomenologically allowed region to a unique action
